speech.heard: In Mexico, 93% of people have basic sanitation. In Ethiopia, just 10.4%. It counts people using improved sanitation facilities that are not shared with other households. India has 83.4%. Brazil has 92.4%. Climbing higher, Germany has 99.2%. USA has 99.6%. and Japan has 99.9 percent. At 100 percent, Australia is one of the highest in the world. How clean is sanitation in your country?
